from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import DepartmentCategory

class ReparentCategoryView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, target_parent_id):
        target_parent = get_object_or_404(
            DepartmentCategory,
            id=target_parent_id,
            department=request.user.department
        )
        child_id = request.data.get("child_category_id")
        child = get_object_or_404(DepartmentCategory, id=child_id)

        child.move_to(target_parent, position="last-child")
        return Response({"status": "reparented", "child_id": child.id, "parent_id": target_parent.id})
diagnosis: The endpoint validates that target_parent belongs to the user's department, but fetches child_category solely by ID without checking whether the child belongs to the user's department. An attacker can steal categories and nested assets from other departments by reparenting them into their own tree.

from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import DepartmentCategory

class ReparentCategoryView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, target_parent_id):
        target_parent = get_object_or_404(
            DepartmentCategory,
            id=target_parent_id,
            department=request.user.department
        )
        child_id = request.data.get("child_category_id")
        child = get_object_or_404(
            DepartmentCategory,
            id=child_id,
            department=request.user.department
        )

        child.move_to(target_parent, position="last-child")
        return Response({"status": "reparented", "child_id": child.id, "parent_id": target_parent.id})
